Label

Form labels identify form controls. They are essential for accessibility and should always be associated with their corresponding input.

Basic Labels

Standard form labels used with inputs.

HTML 
<label class="zak-form-label" for="name">Name</label>
<input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input" placeholder="Enter name">

Required Label

Mark fields as required with an asterisk indicator.

HTML 
<label class="zak-form-label zak-form-label-required" for="name">Full Name</label>
<input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input" required>

Optional Label

Indicate optional fields with an "optional" badge.

HTML 
<label class="zak-form-label" for="phone">
  Phone Number
  <span class="zak-form-label-optional">(optional)</span>
</label>
<input type="tel" id="phone" class="zak-input">

Label Sizes

Use size modifiers to match labels with different input sizes.

HTML 
<label class="zak-form-label zak-form-label-sm" for="small">Small Label</label>
<input type="text" id="small" class="zak-input zak-input-sm">

<label class="zak-form-label" for="default">Default Label</label>
<input type="text" id="default" class="zak-input">

<label class="zak-form-label zak-form-label-lg" for="large">Large Label</label>
<input type="text" id="large" class="zak-input zak-input-lg">

Floating Labels

Labels that float above the input when focused or filled.

HTML 
<div class="zak-form-group zak-form-floating">
  <input type="text" id="floating-name" class="zak-input" placeholder=" ">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="floating-name">First Name</label>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-group zak-form-floating">
  <input type="email" id="floating-email" class="zak-input" placeholder=" " value="john@example.com">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="floating-email">Email Address</label>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-group zak-form-floating">
  <textarea id="floating-msg" class="zak-textarea" rows="3" placeholder=" "></textarea>
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="floating-msg">Your Message</label>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-form-labelBase label
.zak-form-label-requiredLabel with required asterisk
.zak-form-label-optionalOptional text inside label
.zak-form-label-smSmall label size
.zak-form-label-lgLarge label size
.zak-form-floatingFloat label wrapper

Accessibility

  • Every input must have an associated <label> using for/id pairing.
  • Never use placeholder text as a substitute for a visible label.
  • Required fields should be indicated both visually (asterisk) and programmatically (aria-required).
  • Floating labels must remain visible at all times — they should not disappear on focus.
  • Use aria-label only when a visual label is truly impossible.
